### CANDIDATE DETAIL
#### 1. phocomelia, Schinzel type  —  Tier 1 — Definitive / Highly Plausible  (fitness 0.743)
**Link type:** shared causal gene (HGNC:12786)

**Proposed mechanism:** WNT7A (HGNC:12786) —DISRUPTS→ Wnt signaling pathway (WP:WP472); Wnt signaling pathway (WP:WP472) —LEADS_TO→ Limb malformation (HP:0001195); Wnt signaling pathway (WP:WP472) —LEADS_TO→ Abnormal skull morphology (HP:0002677). Loss-of-function mutations in WNT7A disrupt the Wnt signaling pathway, leading to limb malformations (characteristic of phocomelia, Schinzel type) and abnormal skull morphology (associated with MONDO:0013077).

**How to falsify it:** The discovery of pathogenic variants in WNT7A with consistent loss-of-function effects in individuals with MONDO:0013077 and phocomelia, Schinzel type (MONDO:0010164) would support this hypothesis. Conversely, identification of distinct causal genes with opposing functional consequences for each disease would falsify this proposed shared mechanism. _(variant: rs745704932)_

**Why it matters:** Understanding the shared role of WNT7A in both conditions could enable the development of targeted therapies that modulate Wnt signaling to address the underlying developmental defects in both MONDO:0013077 and phocomelia, Schinzel type.
